text:
maya: Heads-up — I'm trying to push canary r1045 into prod during today's change window but deploy-bot is blocking with an approval_backfill. Can someone advise if we should force-approve or backoff+retry?

deploy-bot: Deployment r1045 -> canary scheduling failed: reason=approval_backfill, required_approvals=2, approvers=[release-leads]. Change window: 2026-03-18T22:00Z-23:00Z. To override use `/deploy approve r1045 --manual` (audit logged).

tom: @maya quick Q: is this a user-facing config change (A/B) or a runtime-only model swap? want to know blast radius.

maya: It's an A/B config change + model variant for the recommender (traffic split 95/5). No schema changes. We'll start at 2% for the new variant and ramp with the rollout guard.

li: i think we should avoid a force-approve. deploy-bot has `--backoff-retry` that will reattempt scheduling after approvals arrive, and we can set `--staggered-window 5m` to avoid hitting the guard. Example:```/deploy schedule r1045 --canary --split "new=2%" --backoff-retry --staggered-window 5m```

li: The rollout guard checks latency and error-rate deltas over the last 5m, so a staged start is safe. If we force through we lose that graceful warmup and risk cache-pressure.

dana: Oncall here — if we need an exception (out-of-window), I can sign off but want a rollback plan. What's the immediate rollback command?

maya: rollback is `/deploy rollback r1045 --to r1044` and we have canary rollback hooks that remove variant and revert traffic split. Telemetry will flag if 5xx or p50 rises >20%.

tom: If @dana is OK to approve an exception, we can run the backoff-retry with `--override-window` + manual approval; that keeps the canary logic intact. Prefer that to `--manual` full force.

dana: i'll approve the exception if li or maya stay on standby for first 10m and monitor the rollout dashboard.

maya: I'll be watching the rollout dashboard and logs (linked dashboard: https://console.redwood/rollouts/r1045). I'll post p50/p90 snapshots at 2m and 10m.

oncall-bot: NOTE: Exception approved by dana at 2026-03-18T22:05Z. Audit ID: ex-20260318-51f3. Reminder: include postmortem comment if any anomalies.

tom: ok let's do this: run `--backoff-retry --override-window` + `--staggered-window 5m`. dana approves, maya + li monitor, tom will watch rollback hook.

maya: running now... `./ci/deploy.sh r1045 --canary --split new=2% --backoff-retry --override-window --staggered-window 5m`

deploy-bot: Deployment r1045 scheduled: canary started at 2026-03-18T22:07Z. Traffic split: new=2%. Guard: latency/error checks active. Will auto-scale split up to 20% if checks pass.

li: seeing initial warmup. no errors in the tail logs, latency stable.

maya: p50=72ms, p90=140ms at +2m. Posting to rollout thread.

dana: good. i'll keep the exception open for 30m and will revoke if any spike. thanks all :thumbsup:

tom: nice. note for follow-up: add a small UX tweak to deploy flow to surface `--backoff-retry` as a suggested option when approval_backfill occurs. It confuses newer engineers.

li: filed PERF-3122 for the UX suggestion.

maya: thanks everyone — closing this thread once the canary hits 20% and we confirm metrics at 10m.
